steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Get it together. That's not a human.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I know!
But she obviously can't hold up her body anymore. She flops down on the floor and starts dry-heaving.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I understand now... That's why those gangsters can use Sinner's power...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Damn it... Those bastards at Parma... How dare they do that to her... How could they do such a thing...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...I don't want to say it.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You have to at least explain this.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...This is an experiment done by a bunch of scumbags.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Those Mania Crystals kept in the jars and robbed by the Syndican gangsters were all extracted from Sinners.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: All those different Mania abilities held by the Mania weapons were all extracted from the Sinners with the respective abilities.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Those bastards tortured us all for this thing.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Those bastards, I have to kill them...
She smashes her fist onto the floor. Her hand is cut and the debris caught in the wound hinders her regeneration.
You hold her hand without saying anything, trying to calm her down.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But we've never seen Mania Crystals go manic to this extent. Why would the substance extracted from Sinners turn into contamination?

options: It must be the effect of the inheritance.

steps.speaker: Remnant Thou Voodoos
steps.content: Go to... <color=#fb9259>the second downward well</color>, the <color=#fb9259>path</color> closer to the inheritance... It's here...
You finally find the second elevator. From the gap of the ajar door, filthy substances continue to leak out.

The sprightly young supply manager leans against the railing, tilting her head back to gaze at the sky, her body nearly folded in half. Shin, who is jotting notes on a clipboard, smiles wearily and places a hand on Emily's back to pull her up.
It must be an extremely evil power, something more fearsome and deeper than you can imagine. You feel fear, not because you want to escape, but because...
Fear is a premonition. If you ignore it, it's bound to cause even worse disasters.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, it's dangerous...
But the inheritance in the underground is even more dangerous, and so is the person going to retrieve it.
Should you turn back, or go even deeper?
That image before you parted ways emerges in your brain. Her eyes and that sentence you didn't catch are now appearing vividly in your mind.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Haha, I'll...
See you down there.
You read her lips.
